packageRules.description: The pnpm.overrides block pins patched releases within a major line. Patch and minor bumps keep those pins current; a major rewrites what the override means and breaks the consumers it was pinning.

typescript-eslint reads the JS compiler API for every type-aware rule, and its latest release (8.65.0) still peers on typescript <6.1.0. TypeScript 7 ships only the native compiler and drops that API. Lift this once the peer range allows 7.
